First tagged release: four modules and 61 functions for Neblex Code steps, each file attached below so you can import it without cloning the repository.

- `data-quality.rhai`: emails (including disposable addresses), phone numbers, names, company names, domains, URLs, US ZIP codes and states, Canadian and UK postcodes, country codes, Luhn check digits and record completeness
- `dates.rhai`: dates in common formats to YYYY-MM-DD, Excel serial dates, Unix timestamps, days and working days, weekday, ISO week, end of month, quarter and fiscal periods
- `numbers.rhai`: US and European number formats, percentages, cents, currency codes, banker's rounding, display formatting, percent change, safe division and durations
- `text.rhai`: accents, slugs, truncation, initials, masking, padding, HTML snippets, word counts, and title, snake and camel case

All 395 test cases pass with the Rhai engine on GitHub and in a Neblex Code step. `SHA256SUMS` lists a checksum for each file.
